values: Preheat the oven to 170°C and butter an 8-inch square tin.
Oven is hot and the tin is prepared
Melt the butter gently, then remove it from the heat.
Butter is liquid but not browned
Whisk the sugar, vanilla and espresso into the melted butter.
Whisk in the eggs one at a time until glossy.
Fold in the flour, cocoa, bicarbonate of soda and salt just until no dry streaks remain.
No pockets of dry flour remain
Scrape the batter into the tin and bake until the centre is just set.
A skewer has moist crumbs rather than wet batter
